title: Zechariah Bible Quiz - Chapter 14
description: Ten questions on Zechariah 14: the day of Yahweh, the Mount of Olives split in two, and the nations that go up to Jerusalem.

questions.text: What happens to half of the city when the nations are gathered against Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:2 says half of the city will go out into captivity, and the rest of the people will not be cut off from the city.

answers.text: It goes out into captivity
It is burned with fire
It flees to Egypt
It is given to Judah

questions.text: What happens to the Mount of Olives when his feet stand on it?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:4 says the Mount of Olives will be split in two, from east to west, making a very great valley.

answers.text: It is covered with a cloud
It is split in two from east to west
It sinks into the sea
It becomes a plain of grass

questions.text: The fleeing in verse 5 is compared to fleeing from what, and in whose days?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:5 says they will flee just as they fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah.

answers.text: From the great flood in the days of Noah
From the fire in the days of Elijah the prophet
From the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah
From the sword in the days of Saul the king

questions.text: Where do the living waters go out from, and how are they divided?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:8 says living waters will go out from Jerusalem, half of them toward the eastern sea and half toward the western sea.

answers.text: From the temple, into seven streams toward the desert
From Lebanon, into the Jordan and down to the sea
From the Arabah, toward the north and the hill country
From Jerusalem, half toward the eastern sea and half toward the western sea

questions.text: What does verse 9 say Yahweh will be?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:9 says Yahweh will be King over all the earth, and in that day Yahweh will be one, and his name one.

answers.text: King over all the earth
A refuge for Egypt
Judge of the priests
A light to the islands

questions.text: What is the plague with which Yahweh will strike the peoples who fought against Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:12 says their flesh will consume away while they stand on their feet, and their eyes and tongue will consume away as well.

answers.text: Their cattle will die in the fields around them
Their flesh will consume away while they stand on their feet
Their cities will be swallowed by the earth
Their rivers will turn to blood before them

questions.text: What wealth of the surrounding nations will be gathered together?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:14 says the wealth of all the surrounding nations will be gathered together: gold, and silver, and clothing, in great abundance.

answers.text: Horses, mules and camels
Grain, wine and oil
Gold, silver and clothing
Cedar, cypress and stone

questions.text: What will those who are left of the nations go up to Jerusalem to do, year by year?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:16 says everyone who is left of the nations will go up to worship the King, Yahweh of Armies, and to keep the feast of booths.

answers.text: Pay tribute to the chieftains of Judah every year
Rebuild the walls of the city with their own hands
Bring their sons to serve the priests in the temple
Worship the King, Yahweh of Armies, and keep the feast of booths

questions.text: What happens to the families of the earth that do not go up to Jerusalem to worship?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:17 says that on whoever does not go up to worship the King there will be no rain.

answers.text: There will be no rain on them
Their kings will be taken captive
Their names will be blotted out
Their land will be given to Judah

questions.text: What will be written on the bells of the horses in that day?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:20 says that in that day there will be on the bells of the horses: HOLY TO YAHWEH.

answers.text: KING OF ALL THE EARTH
GLORY TO THE TEMPLE
PEACE TO JERUSALEM
HOLY TO YAHWEH
